title: Digital-channel fraud, transaction risk and protective friction
workflow: Collect lawful security and behavioral signals with purpose restrictions
Evaluate approved transaction, account, device and customer controls
Present step-up, denial or review without leaking confidential fraud rules
Bind any approval to unchanged financial command digest
Escalate suspicious, uncertain or conflicting signals for human review
Preserve decision evidence and subsequent account/incident correlations
invariants: Fraud signal is not an independent declaration of legal guilt
Unapproved model or data inputs cannot decide regulated access
Risk denial must not silently mutate financial journals
Unknown risk result cannot be normalized to safe by default
Protected characteristics and proxies require fairness/privacy scrutiny
Cross-institution risk events never leak customer information
Fraud exception override requires accountable independent checker
acceptance_tests: Unverified high-risk signal triggers review state
Challenge on modified payment digest invalidated
Privileged risk override logged and independently authorized
independent_gate: Bank fraud/AML policy, privacy fairness review, risk governance and actually executed adversarial tests.
